description: Retrospective time-blocked validation for the 24 dark-port BMP frames. Historical tuning saw all frames; this split is for leakage-aware internal comparison, not an independent external test.
notes: Frames 21-24 have 2026-03-27 mtimes; the calibration blocks have 2026-04-20 mtimes.
Frames 13 and 14 remain in one block because they share the localized stripe state.
A future acquisition batch is required for a genuinely independent test.
